name: Heimdell Tech AI Assistant
description: Answers questions about Heimdell Tech Ai Ltd, a UK software development and IT consultancy (Preston, Lancashire) that helps businesses get ready for AI agents (A2A, AP2, UCP, MCP and Knowledge Catalog) and also runs telecom third-party verification (TPV) compliance services, covering services, pricing, service areas, expertise and policies.

skills.name: Company knowledge and FAQ
skills.description: Answers factual questions about Heimdell Tech Ai's services, pricing, service areas, expertise and policies. Answers are drawn verbatim from a curated knowledge catalogue and returned with source URLs.
examples: What does Heimdell Tech Ai do?
What is AP2 and how do AI agents pay?
What is the difference between A2A, AP2, UCP and MCP?
Is there a free way to check how AI agents see my website?
Do you cover Scotland and Wales?
